clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel needs to discuss the tainted wolf hearts. High Executor Hadrec sends you back to the Royal Apothecary Society researcher with your findings.

After you help the Deathstalkers across Silverpine Forest, High Executor Hadrec gives you an urgent message from Apothecary Renferrel. Renferrel has studied the discolored wolf hearts gathered from local wildlife and needs you at once.

Apothecary Renferrel works for the Royal Apothecary Society in a laboratory inside the Sepulcher crypt. He studies how dark magic and disease are changing Silverpine's beasts, bringing alchemical research together with military reports from the front.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons. He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
